B:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an undirected graph, performs a BFS-based edge orientation procedure with parity flags d, and prints either -1 or the resulting directed edges in 1-based coordinates." B]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read n and m from the first input line using LI, and initialize v as an empty list. RESULT n_m_v]
            [COMMAND For each index from 0 to n-1, append a new empty list to v. RESULT v]
            [COMMAND Initialize f as a list of n zeros and dic as a defaultdict whose missing keys default to 0. RESULT f_dic]
            [COMMAND For i in range(m), read a and b via LI, subtract 1 from both to convert to 0-based indices, append b to v[a], append a to v[b], increment f[a] and f[b], and set dic[(a,b)] and dic[(b,a)] to 1. RESULT graph_state]
            [COMMAND Initialize ans as an empty list, d as a list of n zeros, q as a deque containing 0, and bfs as a list of n ones; set bfs[0] to 0. RESULT traversal_state]
            [COMMAND While q is nonempty, pop x from the left side of q and initialize s as an empty list. RESULT x_s]
            [COMMAND Within the BFS while loop, for every neighbor y in v[x], if dic[(x,y)] is nonzero append y to s, and if bfs[y] is true append y to q and set bfs[y] to 0. RESULT s_updated]
            [COMMAND Within the BFS while loop, if s is nonempty and len(s) is odd and d[x] is truthy, for each y in s append (x,y) to ans, set dic[(x,y)] and dic[(y,x)] to 0, and set d[x] to 0. RESULT odd_truthy_processed]
            [COMMAND Within the BFS while loop, if s is nonempty and len(s) is odd and d[x] is falsy, for each y in s except the last append (x,y) to ans and clear both dic directions for that edge, set d[x] to 0, let y be the last element of s, toggle d[y] with xor 1, append (y,x) to ans, and clear dic[(x,y)] and dic[(y,x)]. RESULT odd_falsy_processed]
            [COMMAND Within the BFS while loop, if s is nonempty and len(s) is even and d[x] is falsy, for each y in s append (x,y) to ans, set dic[(x,y)] and dic[(y,x)] to 0, and set d[x] to 0. RESULT even_falsy_processed]
            [COMMAND Within the BFS while loop, if s is nonempty and len(s) is even and d[x] is truthy, for each y in s except the last append (x,y) to ans and clear both dic directions for that edge, set d[x] to 0, let y be the last element of s, toggle d[y] with xor 1, append (y,x) to ans, and clear dic[(x,y)] and dic[(y,x)]. RESULT even_truthy_processed]
            [COMMAND After the BFS while loop finishes, compute the sum of all entries in d. RESULT parity_sum]
            [COMMAND If parity_sum is nonzero, print -1. RESULT failure_output]
            [COMMAND If parity_sum is zero, for each pair (i,j) in ans print i+1 and j+1 separated by a space on its own line. RESULT success_output]
            [COMMAND Return None from the method. RESULT none]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
